description: Grok Bot's official .deb or .rpm, by its package and its desktop entry.
why: One install writes a package row and a desktop entry, so must_find alone would pass with either broken. must_contain names the package row: the probe closes the quote after grok-bot, so the desktop entry's id does not satisfy it. require_rows names the desktop entry. Cursor is forbidden because Anysphere builds both and both ship a deb, an rpm and a .desktop file, and Grok Build because both carry the Grok name.
known_gaps: The AppImage, the feed's own download, leaves no package record and no .desktop file unless the user integrates it.
A match says the Grok Bot app is installed, not that a Bot ran or that a plan includes it.
